items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Like, take the movie stars like George Ralph, and Harry James, and all them fellas, you know, they'd be in town playing a theater or something... That's why that happened.

ctx.x: And uh, he played with Rennie and this guy played with Bocard Petit, he's downtown now, way downtown there. That beats me. Yeah, he got a house down there, he don't play much now. You ask Raph about it, Raph took me to his house. Raph knew him good. He lives downtown. Way downtown, yeah.
